positions.description:
Zavvy offers a comprehensive solution for people enablement to enhance performance, development, and retention. It covers career development, performance management, learning management, and engagement in one easy-to-use AI-powered product suite.
Many of Europe’s most successful scale-ups use Zavvy, such as Moss (Germany), Typeform (Spain), Storyblok (Austria), Primer (UK), and many more.
Acquired by Deel in 2024.
